newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary sees MVM tender not sooner than end-1997.
newsitem.headline: Hungary sees MVM tender not sooner than end-1997.

text.p: The earliest date for Hungary to announce a tender for the privatisation of the national electricity supply company MVM is at the end of 1997, privatisation minister Judit Csiha said on Thursday.
The daily Vilaggazdasag quoted Csiha as saying that the state privatisation agency APV would submit its alternative proposals about MVM's privatisation to the government by July.
Hungary may privatise MVM through a bourse listing, or may sell the company to strategic investors who could finance the developments which MVM needs, Csiha said.
However, one of the proposals says that privatisation is not necessary as MVM could finance the developments from its own resources and loans, she added.
Hungary privatised its electricity and gas distribution companies at the end of 1995 and in early 1996.
